name: Quick verdict (compact, skim-friendly)
angle: A reader who wants the verdict and the numbers fast.
intent_summary: Compact brand-review page about the Incaspin online casino for players from Poland, built for a reader who wants the verdict and the numbers fast: what the casino is, the key facts in one table, the games and providers, the welcome package with its terms, weekly promotions and loyalty, sign-up, payments, mobile play, licence and identity checks, sports betting, responsible gambling, support and a short FAQ. Page voice: short, dense paragraphs of two to three sentences, sentences of about 14 words on average with an occasional longer one, every section opens with its most useful figure and ends with what it means for the player, no scene-setting and no hook sentences, calls to action only at the welcome package and at the verdict. All brand facts come from the AffBulk knowledge base incaspin-new; nothing is claimed about the legal status of the casino in Poland.
